sloka: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सम्पश्य राघव ।उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम् ॥ २.१११.२३॥
transliteration: etaccaivobhayaṁ śrutvā samyak sampaśya rāghava ।uttiṣṭha tvaṁ mahābāho māṁ ca spṛśa tathodakam ॥ 2.111.23॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed son of the Raghus, you have heard both (them and me). Carefully think over. Arise. Touch me and sip water.
